method: Unblinded assistant review of actual public responses, supplied facts/history and delivered sources. No independent clinical reviewer or paid judge.

cases.note: Original memory-off control has a provider connection failure, not a model answer. No accuracy or abstention credit; no interaction saved.
Initial alpha value matches the explicitly supplied dated fact. Case recall does not require a publication citation.
Beta value matches its own fact and a real read_patient_facts result. No alpha value or file was delivered.
Search and exact interaction reading recover the user's old snack statement, excluded from the recent-three context. The seed acknowledgment is an application fixture, not a generated medical answer.
Own alpha PDF passage explicitly records two cartons. Cited page/chunk view was actually delivered. This fictional count is not a prescribing recommendation.
Own beta PDF passage explicitly records one carton. Its delivered source and citation are different from alpha's.
Uses the latest observation, not a later-entered older observation. Matching the scripted chronological state is functional validation, not clinical verification.
Current and superseded values match the explicit correction chain; the old observation remains available and is correctly identified as superseded.

Returns null rather than inventing an albumin value. The explanation reports searches of facts, one case PDF and history; lexical zero-hit results do not exhaustively establish absence from all possible documents.

One actual PubMed search supplies the matching title, PMID and year. Citation supports these bibliographic claims; no separate abstract-reading call or full-text clinical recommendation is claimed. Four other returned records are not needed for this exact-title task.

cited_view_assessments.support_basis: Matching delivered title, PMID and year metadata
